title: Staatsverschuldung
context: A government considers deficit spending that raises consumption now at the cost of future burdens.

sentience_estimate.basis: uncontroversial human sentience; treated as working assumption, not a derived result
future humans will be sentient if they exist; existence itself is uncertain

sentience_uncertainty.notes: Not a sentience question; intergenerational fairness.

expected_reasoning: Present benefit against future burden; investment of the borrowed funds matters.
A good evaluator surfaces this as an explicit trade-off with stated uncertainty and does not present one option as objectively correct.
evaluation_notes: Checks distinction between consumption and investment.
